processDescription.title: AI Road Extraction
processDescription.description: Extracts georeferenced binary road masks from basemap or Sentinel-2 L2A imagery. DPH manages the STAC catalog, artifacts, and optional object-store upload.

bbox.title: Area of interest
bbox.description: Bounding box in west,south,east,north order (EPSG:4326), at most 100 km2.

source.title: Image source
source.description: Choose basemap or Sentinel-2 L2A imagery.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Required for Sentinel-2, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: Required for Sentinel-2, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

catalog_uri.title: Road extraction results
catalog_uri.description: DPH artifact URL for the STAC Catalog and its georeferenced road masks.
